item.title: Storage Ottoman vs. Coffee Table With Drawers: Which Works Better?
item.description: A storage ottoman and a coffee table with drawers both hide clutter, but they solve different problems. An ottoman is usually better for bulky soft items and relaxed seating. A drawer coffee table is usually better for small daily objects and a dependable hard surface. The best choice is not the piece with the largest advertised storage volume. It is the one that holds what you need while leaving room to walk, sit, open drawers and use the sofa.
